newsitem.title: USA: Beacon Properties acquires office tower.
newsitem.headline: Beacon Properties acquires office tower.

text.p: Beacon Properties Corp said on Wednesday it had acquired a 33-story office tower located in the heart of Boston's downtown financial district for $280 million.
The property contains about 930,000 square feet and is nearly 100 percent leased, Beacon said.
The company added that it expected an unleveraged return in the first full year of 9.1 percent, excluding straight-line rents. The building is located at 225 Franklin Steet.
"This brings our holdings in the financial district to 14 properties totaling approximately five million square feet," said Beacon president Alan Leventhal.
Beacon Properties Corp is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust.
It did not say who owned the property previously.
